summary: Full UI regression of the redesigned Project Workspace editor (/app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx) after the DS Tabs + Lucide + typographic Section redesign. Tested against seeded project 6fcd0548e5f3 ('Solstice Perfume — Launch Film', 3 scenes) as wsdesign@studio.com on BOTH mobile (390x844) and desktop (1280x900). 14/14 acceptance flows PASS: (1) email login lands on /dashboard; (2) header renders title, 'Aurelia Paris · Commercial · 3 scenes · 30s' meta line, editor-back/undo-btn/redo-btn/export-btn/director-open buttons all present; (3) all 10 DS underline tabs (Overview/Storyboard/Script/Shot List/Equipment/Crew/Schedule/Budget/Exports/Settings) switch cleanly with no crash or blank content and no red screen; (4) Overview ov-title edits trigger the header save indicator (Saved dot); ov-duration picker opens a bottom sheet with the current selection marked; ov-camera MultiSelect opens a sheet with option list + custom-value input + Add button; (5) Storyboard toggle-0 expands/collapses, add-scene adds a 4th scene, Summary panel renders on mobile; (6) undo-btn/redo-btn correctly reverse & replay the add-scene mutation (scenes went 3→4→3→4→3); (7) Shot List, Script (screenplay style with 01/02/03 numbering), Equipment, Crew, Schedule and Budget tabs all render AI-generated content without runtime errors; (8) Exports tab renders the new flatter ExportCard rows for export-pdf/export-csv/export-print (all pressable, no crash); (9) Settings set-fav and set-archive toggles work without crash, set-delete opens the confirm modal exposing set-confirm-delete (dismissed via ESC, NOT confirmed); (10) director-open opens the AI Director panel. Same tab switching also verified at 1280 desktop viewport.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19. ref is now a regular prop.' fires every time the Storyboard tab mounts. Non-blocking (drag/reorder still functions) but will break on the next RN/Reanimated bump. The library needs to be upgraded to a React-19-compatible version or replaced. Reference: /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx:780-800

Multiple 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' warnings across the workspace redesign (e.g. sbCardActive shadow). Reference: /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx:912 (sbCardActive) and other shadow* entries in the same StyleSheet.

'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' warning appears on the redesigned screen (ToastProvider uses pointerEvents="box-none" as a prop). Reference: /app/frontend/src/ui/DS.tsx:135.

action_items: MINOR: Missing i18n key 'common:actions.open' (console: '[i18n] Missing key: common:actions.open'). Add translation or remove reference.

MINOR: Upgrade react-native-draggable-flatlist to a React 19 compatible version (or shim) to silence the 'element.ref was removed' console.error emitted whenever the Storyboard tab is rendered. Not user-visible but noisy and will become a hard error on the next major RN upgrade.

MINOR: Migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents (also flagged in iteration_14). Applies to /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx (sbCardActive shadow) and /app/frontend/src/ui/DS.tsx (ToastProvider pointerEvents).
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/project/[id].tsx is 1051 lines — over the 700 line threshold. The Overview, StoryboardTab, SceneCard, StoryboardFrame, CommentsPanel, SettingsTab and createStyles blocks are all defined inline; extracting SceneCard + StoryboardFrame + CommentsPanel into /app/frontend/src/editor/ modules would materially improve readability and reduce re-render surface. Not a regression, but the redesign is a good moment to split.

Module-level mutable palette pattern (`let C: Palette = darkPalette; let styles: any = createStyles(darkPalette);` at file scope, then reassigned inside Editor()) is fragile — top-level helpers like statusTone/frameStatusMeta close over the initial darkPalette until Editor re-runs. Consider moving statusTone/frameStatusMeta into the Editor scope or into a small hook so they always resolve against the active theme.
The redesigned Storyboard tab still uses the OLD SceneCard visual (as intentionally called out in the review request) — flagged here only as a reminder for the next dedicated redesign task.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (14/14 workspace regression flows pass on both mobile 390 and desktop 1280)

seed_data_creation: None. The add-scene test added a 4th scene to project 6fcd0548e5f3 which was then reverted via undo-btn, leaving the seeded project intact with its original 3 scenes. Favorite/archive toggles were also toggled back to their original state. The delete modal was opened but NOT confirmed, so the project was preserved as required.

DS Tabs underline nav, Lucide icons, typographic Section wrappers, screenplay-style Script tab and flatter Export/Settings cards all render correctly on both viewports. testIDs are unchanged so existing selectors continue to work. Only outstanding noise is the React 19 'element.ref' console.error from react-native-draggable-flatlist on the Storyboard tab, plus the pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents deprecation warnings. Seeded project id 6fcd0548e5f3 is left in its original state (3 scenes, no favorite, not archived).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no regression found. The workspace redesign preserves all handlers and testIDs (Header buttons, DSTabs onChange -> setTab, Overview EditableField/Picker/MultiSelect commit, StoryboardTab addScene/toggle-N, Settings set-fav/set-archive/set-delete, AI Director) so no functional regression was introduced.
